SUNOG SA CAMP CRAME

Naapula na ang sunog na sumiklab sa isang bahagi ng PNP General Hospital sa loob ng Camp Crame sa Quezon City nitong Linggo ng gabi, August 24.

Pasado alas-10 ng gabi nang sumiklab ang sunog at umakyat pa sa unang alarma bago naapula bandang 11:21 ng gabi.

📸: Baseco Fire & Rescue Volunteer Assoc.

data.text:
🚨 Endless Hellfire 🚨

Philippines today feels like living in a slow-burning hellfire, and the poor are the first ones to get scorched.

Floods swallow communities while corrupt officials pocket the budget for flood control. Traffic is no longer just inconvenience,  it’s daily torture that robs people of time and dignity. Drugs keep crawling back into the streets, fueling more crimes, more broken families, more bodies in alleys. Prices of food and basic goods climb beyond reach, leaving the poor choosing between hunger and debt. Even electricity, a basic necessity,  flickers and dies with brownouts, dragging people back to darkness.

This isn’t just hardship. It’s systematic suffering, where the ordinary Filipino pays the price of corruption, neglect, and incompetence. And unless leaders start treating this like the emergency it is, the country will keep burning while the poor are left with nothing but ashes.

[6:30PM] #MushinOshodi #TrafficUpdate 

Movement around Mushin is mostly smooth.
Traffic along Moshalasi to Ojuwoye, Oshodi Underbridge to Brown Junction, and return journey from Bolade to Ojuwoye are all moving well. 
Some slight congestion is reported near the Oshodi Train Station due to commercial activities, but officers are managing the situation. 
Other stretches like Ojuwoye to Lasutech and Ile Epo to LUTH Junction are moving as expected. 
No major impediments are reported, and officers are on ground ensuring smooth traffic flow.
